results.quote: The strongest single outcome is for unit-square stabbing, where the search attains an integrality gap of 20/13≈1.54: a family of twenty congruent squares with set-cover LP optimum τ*=13/5 against an integer optimum τ=4 (Figure 3). This is a major achievement, since it strictly exceeds the best lower bound of 3/2 previously known in the literature (Section 3) and is found automatically with an independently verified certificate.

Working in the staircase formulation, the search reaches a certified unit-square stabbing gap of τ/τ*=14/9≈1.555. This exceeds both the best previously known lower bound of 3/2 and the automated search's best of 20/13 (Section 5).
